scripts.typecheck: npm run build:rules && tsc -p packages/rules/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @ctf/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @ctf/client
scripts.test: npm run build:rules && npm run build --workspace @ctf/server && node --test packages/rules/test/*.test.mjs apps/server/test/*.test.mjs tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:rules && npm run build --workspace @ctf/server && npm run build --workspace @ctf/client
